from fastapi import FastAPI
import httpx

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/preview")
async def preview(url: str):
    response = await httpx.get(url, timeout=5)
    return {"status": response.status_code, "body": response.text[:500]}
description: The route fetches a user-controlled URL without scheme, host, IP range, or redirect allowlist checks. Attackers could target internal metadata or private services.
evidence: demo-site SSRF scenario: httpx.get(url) is called with the raw request parameter.
title: SSRF risk in URL preview endpoint
